description: This file defines the LDAPUserCollection class in the OrangeHRM LDAP module, encapsulating collections of LDAPUser objects, duplicate usernames, users with duplicate usernames, and failed users. It provides methods to access these collections and compute duplicate user count.

classes.name: LDAPUserCollection
classes.description: A class that manages various collections of LDAPUser objects, including duplicates and failures, with methods to access these collections and compute the total number of duplicate users.

methods.name: getLDAPUsers
methods.description: Returns the array of LDAPUser objects keyed by username.

methods.name: getDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns the list of usernames identified as duplicates.

methods.name: getUsersOfDuplicateUsernames
methods.description: Returns a map of usernames to arrays of LDAPUser objects where usernames are duplicated.

methods.name: getDuplicateUserCount
methods.description: Calculates and returns the total count of LDAPUser instances associated with duplicate usernames.

methods.name: getFailedUsers
methods.description: Returns the list of users that failed during LDAP processing, represented by their distinguished names.
